settings.label: Take-off and landing
settings.info: On: the drone spins up in front of the rider, rises, and flies back to land. Off: G puts it up in its FPV camera at once and brings it back at once.

settings.label: Throttle
settings.info: Hover: the left stick's centre hovers (down falls, up climbs). Full range: bottom is 0, centre half, like a radio's throttle. Trigger: RT.

settings.label: Stick mode
settings.info: Mode 2: throttle and yaw left, pitch and roll right. Mode 1: pitch and yaw left, throttle and roll right.

settings.label: RC rate
settings.info: Betaflight rates: how fast it turns around the centre (200 deg/s x RC rate at full stick before super rate).

settings.label: Super rate
settings.info: Raises the turn rate towards full stick: 1.0 / 0.7 / 0 gives about 670 deg/s.

settings.label: Expo
settings.info: Softens the sticks around the centre.

settings.label: Thrust to weight
settings.info: Full throttle lifts this many times the drone's weight; it hovers at 1 / this throttle.

settings.label: Camera tilt
settings.info: How far the camera looks up from the nose: more for faster flying. In flight the d-pad's up / down (or the arrow keys) change it in 5 degree steps; the last value stays.

settings.label: Field of view (vertical)
settings.info: In flight the d-pad's left / right (or the arrow keys) change it in 5 degree steps; the last value stays.

settings.label: Drone model
settings.info: The drone seen in the world while it launches, flies and comes back (the Alps only for now; built when the game starts). The game's drone is rebuilt from your install; both are drawn with a borrowed bench's materials.

settings.label: Drone model in the FPV view
settings.info: Off: the model is put away while you fly first-person (its props can show at the edges of the picture).
